name: daily_report
description: Operational summary for one property-day, computed live from the current tables. Returns occupancy (totalRooms, occupied, percent), revenue, roomsSold and adr. This is the live view; audit_report is the stored snapshot.

propertyId.description: UUID of the property. Required: this agent is chain-level, so the property is never implied.

date.description: Operating date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

name: audit_report
description: The stored night-audit run for one property-day, under metrics.*. A 404 NOT_FOUND means the audit has not run for that date yet, which is the normal pre-audit state and a useful signal rather than an error.

date.description: Operating date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

name: compare_metrics
description: Read both the live daily report and the stored audit report for one property-day and diff the overlapping metrics. Prefer this over reading the two separately: the two endpoints report the same day under different field names, and both publish a field called 'adr' computed from different denominators (room revenue over rooms occupied versus room revenue over rooms sold). This tool returns both source values per metric plus an explicit discrepancies list, including the cause of an adr divergence. Report discrepancies as findings; never silently pick whichever number you saw first.

date.description: Operating date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

name: list_stays
description: List stays at one property. Use this to find exceptions the audit needs cleared first: a stay still CHECKED_IN whose checkOutDate is already in the past is the classic blocker. NO_SHOW is never set by this platform, so do not look for it or infer it.

status.description: Stay status filter. One of CONFIRMED, CHECKED_IN, CHECKED_OUT, CANCELLED.

name: list_folios
description: List folios at one property. Use this to find unsettled balances that must be resolved before the audit runs.

status.description: Folio status filter. One of OPEN, CLOSED, VOIDED. Filter to OPEN to find unsettled balances.

name: room_board
description: Room status counts and per-room status for one property. Use this to find rooms stuck mid-state (CLEANING or INSPECTING) that will distort the audit's occupancy figures.
